A '''distress buoy''' was a type of [[Distress beacon/Legends|emergency beacon]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. When the [[Curich-class shuttle|''Curich''-class shuttle]] [[Resurgence (Curich-class)|''Resurgence'']] was attacked and damaged by a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[The Irregulars|Irregular]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gorgi]] released a distress buoy before making an emergency landing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abonshee]].<ref name="Godking" />
